details.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (cue-content): Both Malay forms are valid for salty soy sauce, and the Indonesian–Malaysian contrast is materially useful. However, the English cue “soy sauce” is broader than the stated salty sense; revise it to “salty soy sauce” or broaden the sense. No false-friend contrast is present. Malaysian usage also has competing forms such as “kicap cair” or generic “kicap,” so “kicap masin” should not be presented as the only Malaysian equivalent. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
